name: Glaze UI — Visual, Spatial, and Interaction Language

requirements.title: Visual Language
requirements.normativeText: Color and visual semantics shall communicate meaning, hierarchy, grouping, and state rather than decoration alone.

requirements.title: Typography
requirements.normativeText: Typography shall use shared roles and responsive metrics for hierarchy, readability, density, and accessibility.

requirements.title: Iconography
requirements.normativeText: Icons shall use one coherent GoreeCloud construction language and remain understandable without color alone.

requirements.title: Shape Language
requirements.normativeText: Shapes and corner radii shall come from shared functional tokens rather than arbitrary values.

requirements.title: Materials and Surfaces
requirements.normativeText: Material effects shall preserve readability and reduce optical cost when accessibility or performance requires it.

requirements.title: Elevation and Depth
requirements.normativeText: Depth shall express hierarchy through the governed eight-level elevation model without excessive visual clutter.

requirements.title: Imagery
requirements.normativeText: Imagery shall follow shared crop, ratio, rounding, loading, placeholder, and error-state behavior.

requirements.title: Illustration and Artwork
requirements.normativeText: Illustration and artwork shall share compatible geometry, lighting, palette, weight, and surface treatment.

requirements.title: Brand Identity
requirements.normativeText: Brand identity shall remain recognizable across products without overwhelming application content.

requirements.title: Spatial Language
requirements.normativeText: Responsive grids shall adapt columns and spatial relationships to available space and form factor.

requirements.title: Spacing System
requirements.normativeText: Spacing shall use standardized semantic increments and component/page spacing roles.

requirements.title: Density
requirements.normativeText: Comfortable, standard, and compact densities shall preserve suitable target sizes for the active input method.

requirements.title: Responsive Layouts
requirements.normativeText: Interfaces shall rearrange composition across size classes instead of merely shrinking.

requirements.title: Component Language
requirements.normativeText: Core reusable components shall share state, spacing, motion, typography, and accessibility behavior.

requirements.title: Interaction Language
requirements.normativeText: Interactive components shall expose the governed twelve-state grammar with immediately understandable changes.

requirements.title: Motion System
requirements.normativeText: Motion shall explain relationships and state changes rather than exist only for decoration.

requirements.title: Motion Tokens
requirements.normativeText: Animation shall use shared duration, easing, spring, acceleration, fade, scale, and slide semantics.

requirements.title: Reduced Motion
requirements.normativeText: Reduced-motion presentation shall replace nonessential movement without hiding essential information.

requirements.title: Gestures
requirements.normativeText: Gesture meanings shall remain consistent across GoreeCloud products unless context justifies variation.

requirements.title: Haptics
requirements.normativeText: Haptic feedback shall be subtle, optional, semantic, and never required for comprehension.

requirements.title: Sound
requirements.normativeText: Sound may reinforce state but shall never be required to understand system state.

requirements.title: Feedback and Status
requirements.normativeText: System activity and outcomes shall clearly expose loading, progress, success, warning, error, offline, sync, pending, and saved state.

requirements.title: Data Visualization
requirements.normativeText: Data visualization shall share Glaze color, type, spacing, interaction, label, tooltip, and accessibility rules.

requirements.title: Content Language
requirements.normativeText: Interface text shall be clear, concise, human-readable, consistent, action-oriented, and minimally technical.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.normativeText: Accessibility shall be structural, propagate where compatible, and take precedence over visual richness.

requirements.title: Adaptive Behavior
requirements.normativeText: Presentation shall adapt to environment and input while preserving product capabilities and authority boundaries.

requirements.title: Theming
requirements.normativeText: Shared themes may control appearance and motion only within accessibility and usability constraints.

requirements.title: Application Personalization
requirements.normativeText: Products may express character through bounded customization while retaining the shared Glaze foundation.

requirements.title: Design Tokens
requirements.normativeText: Core design decisions shall be represented by the governed thirteen token categories.

requirements.title: Glaze UI Design Layers
requirements.normativeText: Glaze shall organize appearance, arrangement, behavior, components, and experience quality into five primary layers.

requirements.title: Core Glaze UI Principle
requirements.normativeText: Every GoreeCloud interface shall feel related without requiring every product to look identical.

boundary: Development source implementation only. Stable 1.5.1 lifecycle, evidence, consumer eligibility, release publication, deployment, and production state remain unchanged.
